L001.heard: At 63, I ran into my ex -husband in Walmart. He was with her. The woman he left me for. She is 41.

L004.heard: The only reason I did not fall apart standing there is because of what my sister handed me a few weeks ago.

L008.heard: I stopped looking in mirrors, I stopped being in photos, and I buried my face under more and more makeup that only made it worse.

L010.heard: I decided this was just what 60 looked like, and I made my peace with disappearing.

L016.heard: I ordered my own before Rosa even left, and the first morning I tried it, the tire just lifted. For the first time in years, I did not look away from my own reflection.

L017.heard: And it was more than my face. I stood taller. I thought back in the photos. I stopped hiding. So by the time that cart hit mine in Walmart, I was not afraid of anyone.

L020.heard: I did not need to say a thing. I did not look back either. Two weeks later, Peter texted me. First time in four years. I read it, I smiled, and I put my phone away.

L021B.heard: Right now, you get two foundation sticks for almost the price of one, plus a free primer, a mystery gift, and free shipping and a full 30 -day money -back guarantee. Go be too busy glowing to look backward.
